messages:
maria (CS): Quick pulse — Clearwater renewal flagged a customer-visible degradation: embeddings route latency spiked ~3x yesterday afternoon. I validated it's impacting search relevance demos in their staging account. Asking for triage and a short plan for the renewal call.
jonathan (Eng): Thanks for flagging. I looked at the traces in Console — saw a surge of batching wait time around 18:12 UTC, and a fallback to slower quantized variant. Root cause might be sudden seq-length increase from their test dataset. Can you paste a sample prompt set?
maria (CS): Pasting a small redacted example below. They batch a multi-document embed call.

> user_docs = ["Q: What happened on invoice #123?\nA: ...", "Q: Notes from client meeting...", "Longer doc (~6k chars) ..."]

maria (CS): Also: they reported 95th p95 latency from their side jumped to ~2.1s per request (was ~650ms). Renewal meeting tomorrow at 14:00 PT, want to avoid escalation.
liam (SRE): FYI I can warm a dedicated pool for them for the call. If batching/kvs is the issue, warming should lower tail latency. We have a free 1h warm window. Want me to schedule now?
sarah (PM): Yes please schedule. Also we should confirm if their SDK usage pins model variants or enables client-side batching config that causes long sequences.
jonathan (Eng): Quick ask: can CS share the exact API payloads (sanitized) and whether they set max_tokens / truncate policies? If sequences are long we should recommend chunking + async rerank.
maria (CS): Shared a sanitized payload via DM to @jonathan. They don't truncate — they send whole docs and rely on server-side truncation. Happy to ask them to try chunking but want an immediate mitigation for the call.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-1749 — "Clearwater embeddings tail latency spike". Assigned to liam, jonathan.
liam (SRE): Plan proposal: 1) Warm dedicated pool for 2 hours around the call. 2) Add a short-term autoscaling rule to keep additional instances ready. 3) Recommend customer try chunking after call. I can do 1+2 now if thumbs up.
maria (CS): +1 from me. Can you confirm cost impact so I can pre-approve with the customer? They'll accept a short warm if we don't surprise their billing.
jonathan (Eng): Warm will add ~0.2 vGPU-hours/minute estimate — I'll DM a slim cost estimate. Also rolling a tiny runtime tweak: reduce batch wait threshold from 12ms -> 6ms for the warmed pool to lower tail for mixed seq lengths. I'll open a quick PR and tag @liam for deploy review.
jonathan (Eng): PR: https://git.redwood/example/PR-embed-wait-config (small, runtime flag only)
liam (SRE): Reviewing now. If good, I'll coord deploy to the warmed pool only. Trying to avoid global rollout.
maria (CS): For the renewal call: I'll present the mitigation plan and propose a post-call follow-up to implement chunking and an eval to confirm quality. Thanks team. If we can confirm warm + flag deploy by EOD, I can update the customer.
liam (SRE): Deploy gated, +1. I'll schedule warm for 13:30 PT and keep it until 15:30 PT. Notifying infra team.
jonathan (Eng): Merged and marked for canary on warmed pool. Will monitor Telemetry for p95 delta. Leaving an alert for 30% p95 regression.
sarah (PM): Nice. After the call let's capture a short runbook: when customers send large doc batches, recommend chunking, set batching thresholds, and offer warm windows for critical meetings.
maria (CS): Sounds good. Blockers: need cost numbers (jonathan), confirmation of warm window (liam) — otherwise I'm unblocked. Today: prep renewal slide with mitigation and next-steps.
jonathan (Eng): Sent cost DM. Also adding a one-line note in the Console docs about "warm windows" so CS can request formally.
liam (SRE): Warm scheduled, ops notified. I'll post an update in this thread when instances are ready.
ops-bot: Deployment job queued: deploy-job-8843 -> warmed-pool. Monitor: https://infra.redwood/deploys/8843
maria (CS): Huge thanks. I'll run the renewal and file postmortem notes here after the call. :thumbsup:
jonathan (Eng): Thanks — will watch metrics during the call.
liam (SRE): Ready status posted: warmed pool live at 13:28 PT.\n(reacts :rocket:)
maria (CS): Closing loop — customer call went well, latency held near baseline during demo. They appreciated the proactive warm. Post-call action: schedule follow-up to implement chunking guidance + share runbook.
